sentences.text: Tides are caused mainly by the moon’s gravity, with help from the sun.
A semidiurnal tide has two high and two low waters each day of roughly equal height, like Florida’s Atlantic coast.
A mixed tide has two highs and two lows of noticeably unequal height, common along much of Florida’s Gulf coast.
A diurnal tide has just one high and one low each day, as in parts of the Panhandle.
Because the tidal day is about twenty-four hours and fifty minutes, high and low water come roughly fifty minutes later each day.
